liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **What's Going On** (1 review): The whole band's performance allows Jerry to connect with the audience [16]
- **Knockin' On Heaven's Door** (1 review): Jerry's emotional impact on this song persists despite his vocal condition [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-09-24.142129.4-TrackMixdown.bm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 191 min [1]
- **gd1988-09-24.nak304.carpenter.89303.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 154 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is good for a crowd source, though Jerry's voice is shot [15]
- **gd1988-09-24.133968.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 160 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [7]. Said about its sound: The matrix mix elevates the experience, overcoming deficiencies in the FM source [20]
- **gd1988-09-24.142105.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 24 songs; 190 min [2]

## Around the show

- The show was sloppy and lackluster, despite an all-star guest cast [18]
- A novelty variety show with unusual guests, ending a long Madison Square Garden run [20]
- Hall & Oates performed only cover songs with the band, no originals [22]
- Mick Taylor joined for West LA Fadeaway and Little Red Rooster [6]
- Suzanne Vega played acoustic guitar and vocals on Chinese Bones and Neighborhood Girls [6]
- Baba Olatunji and Michael Hinton performed drums; Olatunji stayed for the rest of the set [6]
- Rainforest benefit featuring Mick Taylor, Suzanne Vega, Daryl Hall, John Oates, and Baba Olatunji [7]
- Rainforest benefit with guests including Mick Taylor, Suzanne Vega, Daryl Hall, John Oates, and Bruce Hornsby [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-09-24.142129.4-TrackMixdown.bm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > PCM Master (Sony ES-HG)Soundboard [1]
- **gd1988-09-24.nak304.carpenter.89303.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA 90's, no Dolby. Mics on stand on floor near sbd [6]
- **gd1988-09-24.133968.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=82486) Recorded by David Minches FM>Sony PCM-601>NEC DX-5000 (Maxell XL-Pro)>Digital Domain VSP-P>Tascam DA-30>Egosys… [7]
- **gd1988-09-24.142105.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > PCM Master (Sony ES-HG) [2]
